scripts.build: npm run build:prod && npm run build:dev:bundles
scripts.build:prod: tsc -b && vite build && vite build --config vite.config.games.ts && vite build --config vite.config.tournaments.ts && vite build --config vite.config.tournament-signup.ts && vite build --config vite.config.onboarding.ts && vite build --config vite.config.communities.ts && vite build --config vite.config.academy.ts && node scripts/write-release.mjs dist release.json && node scripts/write-release.mjs dist release-ffc-academy.json
scripts.build:dev:bundles: vite build --mode dev && vite build --config vite.config.games.ts --mode dev && vite build --config vite.config.tournaments.ts --mode dev && vite build --config vite.config.tournament-signup.ts --mode dev && vite build --config vite.config.onboarding.ts --mode dev && vite build --config vite.config.communities.ts --mode dev && node scripts/write-release.mjs dist release-dev.json && vite build --config vite.config.academy.ts --mode dev && node scripts/write-release.mjs dist release-ffc-academy-dev.json
scripts.build:academy: tsc -b && vite build --config vite.config.academy.ts && node scripts/write-release.mjs dist release-ffc-academy.json
scripts.build:academy:dev: tsc -b && vite build --config vite.config.academy.ts --mode dev && node scripts/write-release.mjs dist release-ffc-academy-dev.json
scripts.build:academy:all: npm run build:academy && npm run build:academy:dev
